task.question: Which stellar nursery was shown in the Webb image released by NASA on October 6, 2026, revealing stars previously hidden by dust about 3,300 light-years from Earth?
task.evidence: a stellar nursery known as NGC 7129
task.page: NASA’s Webb Captures Commotion From Nebula’s Stellar Jets

answer:
The stellar nursery shown in the Webb image released by NASA on October 6, 2026, is the "Lagoon Nebula." 

FINAL: Lagoon Nebula
